note: Your Estes motors were flying the wrong thrust curve. When a file named a motor, the app searched three hand-written built-ins FIRST, by nothing but the start of the designation - so any file asking for a C6 got the built-in C6 whoever made it. The published database is now searched first, and the maker named on your file is honoured. This MOVES NUMBERS: an Estes C6 was flying 10.40 Ns and now flies the certified 8.82 Ns (18 percent less), an Estes A8 was flying 1.89 Ns and now flies 2.50 Ns. Re-open and re-run anything with a small black-powder motor. Also in this release, from a twelve-agent engineering audit of the whole app: an inner tube or nose weight you place off the centreline now flies there instead of on the axis, a transition exports the shape you drew rather than a different one, the Max Mach tile no longer blanks the whole designer, a freeform fin cannot be dragged into a shape that breaks the design, and the Recovery sizing panel has moved beside the component properties and folds up.
